item.title: From field to future: Solar and battery storage as practical diversification strategy - Farmers Guide
item.description: Diversification can mean anything that brings additional revenue or reduces costs to improve profit. It might be a new crop, a farm shop, a processing unit, holiday accommodation, or rented storage space. Increasingly, however, farmers are exploring renewable energy as a practical alternative – particularly solar panels and battery storage.

item.title: Wet winter restores water supplies but brings flooding on farmlands - Farmers Guide
item.description: Above-average rainfall means England’s water levels have now largely recovered from last year’s drought. However, it also led to widespread flooding.

item.title: Balmoral Show cancels poultry classes amid ongoing bird flu restrictions - Farmers Guide
item.description: There will be no poultry classes at Balmoral Show due to uncertainty over bird flu restrictions, the Royal Ulster Agricultural Society confirmed.

item.title: Spotlight on BTV-3: Some questions answered - Farmers Guide
item.description: The ongoing reports of BTV-3 in the UK suggest that this is a disease challenge we will continue to face in 2026. Sioned Timothy, Boehringer Ingelheim's technical services manager - livestock, offers some advice.
